question: What is the parent technique of attack technique 'T1565.003: Data Manipulation: Runtime Data Manipulation'?
answer_text:
Gathered 1 record(s) from 1 source(s).
Found ATT&CK record T1565.003: Runtime Data Manipulation. T1565.003 (Runtime Data Manipulation): Adversaries may modify systems in order to manipulate the data as it is accessed and displayed to an end user, thus threatening the integrity of the data.(Citation: FireEye APT38 Oct 2018)(Citation: DOJ Lazarus Sony 2018) By manipulating runtime data, adversaries may attempt to affect a business process, organizational understanding, and decision making.

Adversaries may alter application binaries used to display data in order to cause runtime manipulations. Adversaries may also conduct Change Default File Association and Masquerading to cause a similar effect.
